title: Imaging Integration-Time Tracker
dataSources: Observatory environment (`observatory:env`), sky-quality meter (`skyquality:reading`), imaging sessions (`imaging:session`), telescope mount (`mount:status`), cloud sensor (`allsky:cloud`).
app: Backyard observatory automation — roll-off-roof/dome controller, sky-quality meter, cloud sensor, telescope mount, and astrophotography capture software (N.I.N.A./Ekos) — logging to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=imaging:session rejected=false
| stats sum(exposure_s) as total_s by target
| eval hours=round(total_s/3600,1)
| sort - hours
description: Adds up the total good exposure time you have accumulated on each deep-sky target across all your nights.
value: Faint objects need many hours stacked over many nights; a running total tells you when a target has enough data to finish.
implementation: Ingest kept-sub exposure times; schedule after sessions and total integration hours per target.
visualization: Bar chart of total integration hours by target.
grandmaExplanation: It adds up all the hours you have spent photographing each object in space, so you know when you have enough.
